friar-chorale.hears: The Friar's chorale in the horns (with the clarinets' echoes), the long notes one hears against the feud: 17.1-18.0, 29.6-31.0, 51.4-57.4, 61.6, 72.7-76.0 s.

brass-blows.hears: From the audio: the climax's brass blows (onset strength >= 2.0, 97.6-122 s, where the trumpets proclaim the Friar's chorale ff), then the hammered F# 122-135.9 s; each the notes struck with it, else the pitch class in octave 4.

feud-accents.hears: The feud's accented attacks: audio onsets of strength >= 0.4 in the feud stretches (0-22.1, 33.3-59.7, 135.9-159.9 s), each with its notes (outer voices).

feud-runs.hears: The scurrying string runs (5+ stepwise notes <= 0.2 s apart, one instrument), the feud's machinery all through the development.

clash-strokes.hears: The sword clashes: cymbal-bright strokes from the audio (5-11 kHz jump >= 9 dB to -20 dB or louder), 95.2-155.6 s; each the top note struck with it, else the pitch class in octave 6 (also single strokes at 21.5 and 59.0 s).

ff-blows.hears: The real ff blows: audio onsets of strength >= 2.4 at -25 dB or louder (97.6-157 s); each with its notes.

rising-strings.hears: The long build's rising string line, notes held >= 0.5 s, 70.8-97.6 s, and the held violin B5 of the hush (58.96-71.3 s).

violins.hears: The violins' line, notes held >= 0.28 s, the whole pack.

low-strokes.hears: Low-band strokes from the audio (timpani, bass drum, bass sforzandi; jump >= 10 dB): the climax's heaviest beats; each the lowest note struck with it.

hush-cover.hears: Cover for the hush 59.7-70.8 s (few transcribed attacks): the notes held >= 0.28 s, plus each audio onset or chord change (B, E, F) as a held note in octave 4.

melody.hears: The voiced-out top line of the whole pack: every instrument, notes held >= 0.28 s at G3 or higher, the top (or the clearly loudest) note of each attack; a note under a higher one still sounding is hidden.

bass-line.hears: The bass line: the lowest note of each attack below D3 (cellos, basses, bassoons; roll and pack), one per 0.25 s.

chord-blocks.hears: Chord blocks: attacks of 5+ notes (roll and pack), thinned to their outer voices, one attack per chord.

winds-line.hears: Every woodwind and horn voice's line: the top of each wind attack held >= 0.28 s, the whole pack.
